title: Help the boat reach the upper canal

props.markdown: You're at the controls! Click on the buttons to open or close each part. If you're stuck, click Hint.

props.title: 3D canal lock to operate
props.textAlternative:
**Text version of the simulation.** The [lock](glossary:lock) is a stone [chamber](glossary:lock-chamber) between two canals, closed at each end by a pair of [gates](glossary:gates). The upper canal is 3 m higher than the lower canal. Each pair of gates has **[paddles](glossary:paddle)**: small sluices you open to let water through.

At the start, your [barge](glossary:barge) is in the lower canal. The lower gates are open and the chamber is at the level of the lower canal; the upper gates and all the paddles are closed.

The lock follows four rules:

- A pair of gates only opens when the water is at the same level on both sides.
- Water only flows downhill: through the upper paddles, from the upper canal into the chamber; through the lower paddles, from the chamber into the lower canal.
- The chamber only fills while its lower gates and lower paddles are closed.
- The boat floats: it rises and falls with the water of the chamber.

Write down the manoeuvres that take the barge up to the upper canal, then compare with this order: sail into the chamber; close the lower gates; open the upper paddles and wait until the chamber is level with the upper canal; open the upper gates; sail out.

events.description: Once the barge has reached the upper canal, show the button that leads on to the explanation.
The button leads on to the next screen.
